run_github_triage: run the github issue triage pipeline for a repo with start and end dates
generate_issue_annotations: generate LLM-based annotations and theme categorization for a DataFrame of GitHub issues
categorize_issues: categorize GitHub issues into themes using LLM inference on issue summaries and metadata
generate_executive_reports: generate executive summary reports with key challenges and overview DataFrames from annotated issues
create_triage_pdf_report: create a PDF report with executive summary, open questions, and key challenges from triage data
